t: 玄宗回馬楊妃死，雲雨難忘日月新。
c: 玄宗回马杨妃死，云雨难忘日月新。
p: Xuán zōng huí mǎ Yáng fēi sǐ, yún yǔ nán wàng rì yuè xīn.
z: ㄒㄩㄢˊ ㄗㄨㄥ ㄏㄨㄟˊ ㄇㄚˇ ㄧㄤˊ ㄈㄟ ㄙˇ ， ㄩㄣˊ ㄩˇ ㄋㄢˊ ㄨㄤˋ ㄖˋ ㄩㄝˋ ㄒㄧㄣ 。
en: When Emperor Xuanzong turned his horse to return, Lady Yang had died; memories of their intimacy were hard to forget, yet the sun and moon shone anew.

wg.en: sun and moon are new (signifying a new era)

t: 終是聖明天子事，景陽宮井又何人。
c: 终是圣明天子事，景阳宫井又何人。
p: Zhōng shì shèng míng tiān zǐ shì, jǐng yáng gōng jǐng yòu hé rén.
z: ㄓㄨㄥ ㄕˋ ㄕㄥˋ ㄇㄧㄥˊ ㄊㄧㄢ ㄗˇ ㄕˋ ， ㄐㄧㄥˇ ㄧㄤˊ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄐㄧㄥˇ ㄧㄡˋ ㄏㄜˊ ㄖㄣˊ 。
en: Ultimately, this was the deed of a sage and brilliant emperor; otherwise, who would be the one in the well of Jingyang Palace?

wg.en: the well of Jingyang Palace (historical allusion to a fallen ruler)
